name: EbillingInvoiceValidator
tagline: Check every outside counsel invoice line against your billing guidelines – inside Power Apps.
description: A complete e-billing review app for legal departments: LEDES 1998B / UTBMS invoice lines are checked against 13 configurable billing-guideline rules (rate card, block billing, vague narratives, daily hours, duplicates, non-billable tasks and expenses, late billing), with suggested reductions, reduce/reject with reasons, firm appeals, invoice approval with an approval limit, dashboards and a LEDES import.
features: Approve compliant lines / apply suggested reductions in one click
Reduce, reject, appeal, uphold and deny with reasons and audit log
Invoice approval with approval limit and lock
Law-firm scorecard and spend by UTBMS phase
Bulk actions, undo, paging for 500+ lines
Power Fx outputs and six events
